title: Login-shell banner contaminates stdout and breaks remote revision parsing (false VERSION_MISMATCH)
symptom: Execution-profile structure checks pass but the version guard reports VERSION_MISMATCH although the remote git rev-parse is correct.
root_cause: OML read the first stdout line, which was the Fisherd login banner, not the revision; unrelated: outer SSH exit codes also inherit login-environment noise, so judge by artifacts and the application's own exit code.
minimal_fix: Parse remote revision output by accepting only a unique 40-hex-character line; TDD with a 'banner + SHA' fixture.
validation: Guard passes on banner-contaminated sessions and still fails on genuine mismatches.
avoid: Disabling the version guard, or trusting outer SSH exit codes over application exit codes and artifacts.

parameters.parse: accept only a unique 40-hex revision line
